# Project

**Messenger-Native SaaS** — reference repository by Heartmade. It demonstrates subscription products whose primary UX lives in **Telegram** (or another messenger), with **Stripe** billing, **Supabase** data, and a lightweight **static landing** front door.

This project is developed as part of **Heartmade Studio**: https://github.com/heartmade-studio/

This file is the LLM entry point: factual, low marketing noise.

## Core architecture

- **Landing**: static HTML/CSS (see `apps/landing/`) — redirects to a Stripe hosted checkout link.
- **Billing**: Stripe Checkout (subscription mode) + webhooks → upsert rows in Supabase.
- **Bot**: Telegram updates POST to `/api/webhooks/telegram`; replies via Bot API `sendMessage`.
- **Data**: Postgres via Supabase; demo table `subscriptions` links `stripe_customer_id`, subscription status, and `telegram_chat_id`.

Heartmade uses this stack pattern for client work; **Moon Cue App** is documented as a case study in `docs/moon-cue-app-case-study.md` without exposing proprietary code.
